summary: Iteration 140 frontend-only AITS Shine + Naam badlo + Rank share + Overall-tab regression. Signed in ONCE as QA learner 7004186276 with sh.fake_name + fake_board_named + fake_overall intercepted in-browser - no real PUT /profile/display-name or writes ever reached jeelive.ai. Ran scope A-F at 390x844 and 320x700. Total 55 assertions, 52 TRUE product PASS and 3 test-script artifacts that were re-verified PASS in the follow-up run (URL-encoded message check, day-specific rank number, bottom-tab testID). ZERO pageerrors. ZERO console errors (besides the known 401 on /auth/refresh before sign-in which is normal). (A) /live: no green outside allowed areas (series-day-strip + series-calendar); 8 series-trend-point-<day> elements pressable; series-trend has 5 gradient/color backgrounds (sky-blue card + royal-blue line family); series-calendar has 13 gradient layers (sand face + edge + animation); streak-done renders with no-green border; series-open-leaderboard navigates. (C) Naam badlo: initial text 'Leaderboard par naam: Learner 08D12DFD', label 'Naam likho'; sheet opens with autofocused aits-name-input, maxLength=20, aits-name-hint counter. c0 no aits-name-remove when unset. c1 empty+save shows 'Pehle apna naam likho.' locally and sends NO request. c2 'Arjun@' + save shows 422 message 'Naam 2 se 20 akshar ka rakho: sirf akshar, ank aur space.' and sheet stays open. c3 'Arjun Sharma' + save closes sheet, note 'Naam save ho gaya. Leaderboard par ab Arjun Sharma dikhega.' is shown, aits-board-you-name updates to 'Leaderboard par naam: Arjun Sharma', aits-board-name-edit-label becomes 'Naam badlo'. c4 reopen prefills 'Arjun Sharma', aits-name-remove present, tap shows note 'Naam hat gaya...' and state reverts; label back to 'Naam likho'. c5 server 429 shows 'Aaj naam 3 baar badal chuke ho. Kal phir try karo.' and keeps sheet open. c6 aits-name-cancel closes sheet. (D) Rank Share: card shows JEELIVE.AI, 'DAY 10 . 10 DEC', '#13', 'ALL INDIA RANK', '4,327 students mein', three stats (252/300 Score, 90.8% Accuracy, 71 Attempted), signature '- Arjun Sharma' (only when named), prefilled message with 67/80 counter; clearing removes quote, typing new text reflects on card instantly; aits-share-whatsapp opens https://api.whatsapp.com/send?text=... containing the typed message AND 'All India Rank: #13' AND the jeelive link (verified decoded); aits-share-more + aits-share-send do not crash; aits-share-about explains browser-only; aits-share-back returns to /series-leaderboard. (E) Overall-series tabs: e1 default (fake_aits non-leaderboard shape) shows NO aits-board-scope-* tabs; e2 after sh.fake_overall registered, tabs 'Har din' + 'Poori series' appear, 'Poori series' shows aits-board-you-rank '#9', label 'Poori series mein aapka Rank', foot 'Har live din ka Score joda jaata hai; practice attempt nahi judte.'; e3 wrong-shape body keeps tabs hidden; e4 preparing state renders aits-board-wait + aits-board-retry on 'Poori series'. (F) Regression: no horizontal overflow at 320px on /live, /series-leaderboard or /tests; no console pageerrors in the run; My Tests surface clean (my-tests-tab-{completed,progress,saved}, attempt-container-<id>, my-tests-search, filter chips, empty state my-tests-empty + my-tests-discover on In progress/Saved tabs with 0 items). NO real paper was started, answered, or submitted. NO real display-name mutation reached the website. NO Misfire/attempts writes.
critical_code_review_comments: series-leaderboard.tsx keeps a module-level `heard` cache keyed by uid so name shows at once on re-entry - clean implementation.
NameSheet.tsx correctly distinguishes local 'empty' validation (short-circuits, no network call) from server 422/429 messages, satisfying the owner's 'website words come through' requirement.
RankShare message loop is pure React state -> card re-renders on every keystroke; no heavy reflow observed. The 80-char cap and counter are consistent with spec.
fake_overall in shine_helpers.py correctly routes AFTER fake_aits so the later handler wins (isSeriesBoard() hides tabs unless response matches schema).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all scope A-F product assertions PASS after de-flaking three test-script artifacts)

seed_data_creation: None. fake_aits + fake_board_named + fake_name + fake_overall intercept routes in-browser only; no state change on the website.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/tests/iter140_aits_shine_name_share.py pattern. Three gotchas: (1) WhatsApp URL has the message URL-encoded (Test%20message%20123) - decode before asserting; (2) different attempt ids in fake_board_named may yield slightly different `you.rank` through build() internals - do NOT hard-code #12 on one day and #13 on another; check the rank is PRESENT, not its exact value; (3) bottom-tab-bar testID for My Tests is 'tab-tests' (routing tab), while the tab bar INSIDE the screen uses 'my-tests-tab-{completed,progress,saved}'. aits-board-scope-all is only present when fake_overall is registered AFTER sign-in; call page.reload() after sh.fake_overall(...) to force useBoard(SERIES_BOARD) to re-fetch. Share card signature line '- <name>' only appears when you.named is true (fake_board_named with a saved state['name']). Known flaky: session rate-limit 429 on repeat sign-ins, so reuse the page/session when possible.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no defects found. All four requested features (shine on My Tests + Score trend + day map with the moving tri-colour border, Overall AITS rank tabs gated on website schema, Naam badlo sheet from the pink Rank card with website error messages passed through verbatim, Rank Share card + WhatsApp/Instagram/generic share with the student's own message) are implemented correctly. The green-is-only-for-completed-days colour restriction is honoured (no stray green anywhere on /live or /series-leaderboard outside series-day-strip + series-calendar).
